THE BEST ROUTE TO
TAKE IS YOUR OWN.
With so many auto manufacturers marching out a parade of parity products, it’s hard not to blend in behind the wheel. But if you’re
one of the few who strive to be different, welcome. At Mitsubishi, we build cars for individuals. Drivers who choose to get where
they’re going in their own way. The 2016 Lancer embodies that bold spirit, offering a unique blend of our leading edge technologies
and time-tested engineering. And while we’re proud of our automotive heritage, we continue to move forward, while staying true to
our independent convictions. After all, individuality is not a destination, but a journey. Drive on.
